messages:
Maya Patel: quick kickoff for Velox Systems onboarding — short thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, and 10-day plan. They plan a gated launch behind a feature flag on 2026-04-12. Primary Velox contacts: Jorge (IT lead), Lina (PM). Goals: 95th pct latency < 200ms for pilot load (~1k rps bursts), pilot uptime >= 99.9%, initial cost target < $0.015/token. Need Private deployment (VPC), KMS integration, and audit docs. Who owns what?

Arun Singh: I can own the integration + smoke tests. Recommendation: use a quantized chat model variant (we've validated throughput on A10G). I'll open a config PR with batching and KV cache enabled. Also need staging creds from Velox to validate network routes.

Priya Gomez: I'll run the onboarding timeline and enablement sessions. Propose 3 live sessions: infra sync (env & network), prompt/quality tuning, and monitoring + runbook. Suggested slots: 4/2 14:00 PST (infra), 4/4 10:00 PST (prompts), 4/6 11:00 PST (monitoring).

Jorge Alvarez: Velox team availability looks like afternoons PST 4/1-4/5. They have an on-prem staging cluster accessible via IP allowlist. We prefer Private deployment into our VPC and KMS keys are ready. Two asks: can you limit logs retention to 30d? and can you provide an export for SOC2 evidence?

Maya Patel: noted on availability and requests. We can scope logs retention to 30d for the pilot. We have a SOC2-ready audit package — I'll attach the export to the onboarding folder. Priya — can you lock the session times and send invites to Jorge + Lina?

Priya Gomez: will do. sending invites now. agenda for infra sync (short):
- network allowlist & firewall checks
- VPC peering / transit config
- KMS key exchange steps
- staging cred handoff
- smoke test owner & success criteria

Arun Singh: sample smoke test I'll run after creds: 
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"velox-llama-q4", "input":"hello"}'
I'll include a small harness that asserts 95thpct latency and retries with exponential backoff. I'll post the PR by EOD 3/30.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated: infra-sync scheduled, SOC2-package attached to /onboarding/velox/documents.

Jorge Alvarez: thanks — quick clarifying Q on success metrics: for the latency SLO can spike bursts be tolerated if the average is within target? We need a clear acceptance gate for our feature flag enablement.

Maya Patel: good question. Proposal: acceptance criteria for flag enablement = 95th pct latency <= 200ms with <=5% dropped requests during a 1-hour stress window at expected pilot rate. If breach, we keep flag off and run fallback to hosted model. Arun will add automated rollback trigger to the harness.

Arun Singh: confirming — I'll add the rollback policy and a dashboard panel for 95/99 pct latencies + error rate. I'll also add a canary config (10% traffic) before full roll.

Priya Gomez: action list I captured: 1) Arun: config PR + harness + rollback (due EOD 3/30). 2) Maya: share SOC2 export + docs (due 3/31). 3) Priya: calendar invites + agenda (sent). 4) Jorge: provide staging creds & allowlist IPs (ASAP). We'll reconvene after infra sync to validate smoke test.

Jorge Alvarez: creds and allowlist posted to secure vault, pinged your team. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: thanks team — will follow up with a short recap doc after the infra sync. tagging owners: @Arun @Priya @Jorge. :white_check_mark:
